assumptions.notes:
買家年行駛 6,000-8,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律採 assumed_km = 7000 × years（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。保養節奏由時間驅動而非里程驅動：官方電動車專區本次重新擷取確認節點為「每半年或 1 萬公里」，本案每年只跑 7,000 km，半年時鐘永遠先到，因此每年回廠 2 次、10 年約 20 次（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx）。官方以里程觸發的加熱器冷卻液（首次 16 萬公里、之後每 8 萬公里）與動力控制單元冷卻液（首次 24 萬公里、之後每 8 萬公里）在 10 年 7 萬公里內都不會到期。低里程同時代表二手售價可高於「不看里程」的行情均值，因此殘值一律引用低里程掛牌並在 source 說明。稅金與保險依規格排除。

本次覆核（第三輪）處理的是 cross-trim reviewer 對本筆與同車系 ES500e 頂級版（lexus-es500e-premium）之間階梯不一致的四項指摘，四項全部成立、全部已改：(1) 原 7 年 34% 高於頂級版 30%，違反「高階款保值率略低」且無理由 → 已下修至 25.8%；(2) 原曲線 5y→7y 只掉 7 點、7y→10y 掉 16 點，中段平、尾段崩 → 已重建為單調減速的斜率；(3) 原 1 年 62% 比頂級版低 7.7 個百分點，幅度過大 → 已收斂至 2.9 個百分點，且該幅度改為由實測配備級距差推得；(4) 原 10 年保養合計 328,000 反而「低於」頂級版的 341,000，與旗艦版多出的 21 吋胎與 AVS 矛盾 → 已重建為 389,000，並逐項標出多出來的錢是哪兩項。方法論上最重要的改動：本筆不再獨立猜一組數字，而是以同車系 ES500e 頂級版的曲線為基準，疊加一個「實測得到的配備級距差」，使兩筆記錄同形、僅差一個級距懲罰。

purchase.source: 官方建議售價 NT$2,500,000。本次覆核重新擷取 Lexus Taiwan 官方新聞稿 https://www.lexus.com.tw/news_detail.aspx?nw=753 ，內含正式價格表並逐字確認四車型：ES 300h 豪華版 1,770,000 / 頂級版 1,970,000、ES 500e 頂級版 2,050,000 / 旗艦版 2,500,000 —— 與前次覆核一致，牌價未修正。同頁同時確認本車的關鍵成本差異來源：AVS 可變阻尼避震系統為旗艦版專屬（頂級版沒有），這是後面保養段 10 年多編 30,000 的依據。第二確認點：Lexus 官網 ES 車款頁 https://www.lexus.com.tw/models/es/price 顯示「NT$177~250萬，500e / 300h」，區間上緣與旗艦版 250 萬相符。powertrain = bev 維持正確（DIRECT4 電子式四驅純電，非 PHEV 亦非油電）。誠實註記：U-CAR 規格表 https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/lexus/es%20electric/7179/spec 在本次覆核全站回 403，前次覆核由該頁取得的「旗艦版 235/45 R21、頂級版 235/55 R19、車重 2,235 kg」未能重新驗證，屬沿用；AVS 則已由官方新聞稿獨立確認，不依賴該頁。
purchase.notes: 折扣採 0：和泰／Lexus 價格紀律嚴格，且此車 2026-04-27 才正式上市（正式售價已較 3 月預售價調降 5 萬，等於折扣先在牌價一次給完），上市 3.5 個月的旗艦車型現金議價空間實質為零；業代給的通常是充電樁安裝或精品包而非降價。onroad_fees 35,000 以「實際支出」列計、不與 discounts 互抵：領牌代辦費約 5,000 + 交車精品（大面積隔熱紙約 18,000、行車紀錄器約 8,000、腳踏墊／防護約 4,000），落在此價格帶 20,000-40,000 區間中段；若業代把精品折抵掉，這筆會更低，屬下修方向。官方新聞稿另載明選購光焰銅車色需另加 30,000 —— 本記錄採標準車色，未計入。依規格排除牌照稅、燃料費、強制險與任意險。real_cost = 2,500,000 − 0 + 35,000 = 2,535,000。本次覆核 reviewer 未對 purchase 提出異議，數字維持不變。

items.name: 過戶規費與代辦手續費
售前整備與美容（真皮座椅、竹紋飾板、21 吋鋁圈整理）
刊登費（8891 個人自售刊登方案）

selling_costs.notes: 以個人自售（private_sale_price）為前提估算，因此含刊登費。250 萬級距的旗艦房車售前整備比一般車高（真皮／竹紋飾板／21 吋鋁圈整理），故取 7,000 而非一般 4,000-5,000；同車系 ES500e 頂級版該筆取 10,000 合計，本筆 11,000 的 1,000 元差額即來自大鋁圈與真皮的整理工。合計 11,000，落在此價格帶 5,000-12,000 的上緣但仍在合理範圍。若改走車商收購（dealer_tradein_price）則過戶與刊登由車商吸收，實際 selling_costs 會接近 0，但售價也隨之降到 dealer_tradein_price。本次覆核 reviewer 未對此段提出異議，維持不變。

value_checkpoints.source:
本次覆核上修（原 1,580,000 / 1,385,000）。Reviewer 指原值比同動力入門版（ES500e 頂級版，70.0%）低 7.7 個百分點、幅度偏大，像整組獨立猜測而非同一車系的階梯——此指摘成立。修正方式是把「級距懲罰」從猜測改成實測。

級距懲罰的實測來源（本次覆核在 8891 https://auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/es 重新擷取，同年式、同動力、同為低里程的乾淨配對）：2025 年式 ES300h 旗艦版 3.0 萬與 3.1 萬公里，兩筆車商售價皆為 1,888,000；2025 年式 ES300h 豪華版 2.0 萬公里 1,588,000。分母採 2021-10 小改款表（旗艦版 2,390,000 / 豪華版 1,930,000）並套用已獨立驗證的牌價漂移 +3.2%（漂移證據見下段）→ 旗艦版 ≒ 2,467,000、豪華版 ≒ 1,992,000。得車商零售保值率：旗艦版 1,888,000/2,467,000 = 76.5%、豪華版 1,588,000/1,992,000 = 79.7%。**同年式同動力下，頂規比入門版低 3.2 個百分點**——這就是本車 1 年點該用的級距差，而不是原研究的 7.7 個百分點。

牌價漂移 +3.2% 的獨立驗證（本次覆核在 SUM https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/LEXUS/ES 取得）：一筆 2022 年式 ES200 頂級版 62,000 公里掛牌 1,188,000，**該筆自行載明「新車價 1,950,000」**，對照 2021-10 價目表的 ES200 頂級版 1,890,000，實際牌價高出 3.2%。這是掛牌方自報的原廠售價，比前次覆核用車名字串推估更硬。

本車數字的推導鏈（全部以車商零售 % of list 為共同基準，再走規格要求的價格鏈）：同車系 ES500e 頂級版該筆記錄的 1 年車商零售等值為 1,640,000 / 2,050,000 = 80.0%；扣 3.4 個百分點級距懲罰得旗艦版 76.6% × 2,500,000 = 1,915,000 車商零售 → 自售 −11%（8-15% 中段）= 1,700,000 → 車商收購再 −12.6%（10-15% 內）= 1,485,000。**1,700,000 是自售價，不是任何掛牌價。** 對 real_cost 的保值率 67.1%，比頂級版的 70.0% 低 2.9 個百分點，與實測的 3.2 個百分點級距差同量級。絕對金額 1,700,000 高於頂級版的 1,460,000（符合「高階款絕對售價較高、比率較低」）。7,000 公里遠低於上述 2-3 萬公里的掛牌樣本，低里程溢價已藉「取級距差下緣 3.4 而非更寬」保守處理。confidence low：ES500e 全台無任何中古在售（2026-04-28 上市），本點是模型值，唯一硬的部分是級距差。

本次覆核上修（原 1,205,000 / 1,055,000），與 1 年點同一原因：級距懲罰改用實測值後全曲線平移。方法一致——同車系 ES500e 頂級版 3 年車商零售等值 1,250,000 / 2,050,000 = 60.8%，扣 4.0 個百分點級距懲罰得 56.8% × 2,500,000 = 1,420,000 車商零售 → 自售 −11% = 1,265,000 → 車商收購再 −13.4% = 1,095,000。級距懲罰在 3 年放大到 4.0 個百分點（1 年為 3.4），理由是旗艦版多出的 450,000 配備（Mark Levinson、大鋁圈、AVS、PVM、HUD）在中古市場的回收率隨車齡遞減，見下方「配備回收率」交叉檢查。

本次覆核重新擷取的 3 年期實際掛牌（8891，2023 年式，全部為低里程）：ES250 F Sport 2.8 萬公里 1,398,000；SUM 上 2023 年式 ES200 三筆 23,088 / 33,947 / 48,227 公里分別為 1,198,000 / 1,179,000 / 1,168,000。以 ES250 F Sport 分母 2,080,000 × 1.032 ≒ 2,147,000 計，車商零售保值率 65.1%；ES200 以 1,710,000 × 1.032 ≒ 1,765,000 計約 66-68%。本車推得的 56.8% 明顯低於這些汽油／油電同齡車，差額即純電折價，方向正確。

配備回收率交叉檢查（本次覆核新增的一致性測試，用來確保曲線不是硬湊的）：旗艦版比頂級版貴 450,000，本記錄各點自售價減去頂級版自售價，即為市場願意為那 450,000 配備回收的金額 —— 1 年 240,000（53%）、3 年 155,000（34%）、5 年 75,000（17%）、7 年 25,000（6%）、10 年 25,000（6%）。單調遞減至 6% 觸底，符合規格所述「旗艦套件的加價在中古市場大部分收不回來」，且永不為負（絕對售價恆高於頂級版）。confidence low：無任何 ES500e 中古成交，介於模型化的 1 年與 5 年 UX300e 實例之間。

全曲線錨定最硬的一點，本次覆核下修（原 1,030,000 / 900,000）。台灣唯一可用的 Lexus 純電中古實例本次已重新擷取確認：SUM https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/LEXUS/UX 上一筆 **2022 Lexus UX300e、35,000 公里、車商售價 888,000**。這筆的里程與本檢查點的 assumed_km 完全相同（35,000），且年均 8,750 公里同屬低里程族群，是同國、同品牌、同純電動力下最接近的真實比較對象。UX300e 原始牌價 1,699,000（72.82 kWh 大電池版 2023 年才進台灣、售價 1,899,000，故 2022 年式必為 1,699,000 版本）→ 888,000 / 1,699,000 = **52.3% 車商零售保值率 @ 4 年**。

同期油電對照（本次覆核同頁取得）：2022 UX250h 44,000 公里 839,000。此點顯示 4 年時純電與油電的保值率差距其實不大，因此本記錄不在 1-5 年段編列重手純電折價，重手折價集中在 7-10 年的電池保證懸崖（見該兩點）。

本車數字推導：同車系 ES500e 頂級版 5 年車商零售等值 1,000,000 / 2,050,000 = 48.8%，扣 4.6 個百分點級距懲罰得 44.2% × 2,500,000 = 1,105,000 車商零售 → 自售 −11% = 985,000 → 車商收購再 −14.2% = 845,000。旁證：8891 上 2020 年式 ES300h 旗艦版 8 萬公里 1,188,000（6 年車，分母 2,390,000 → 49.7%），本車 5 年推得 44.2% 低於同齡油電旗艦版，方向正確。此期間仍受「準時定保 → 免費第 5 年 / 14 萬公里延長保證」覆蓋（官方原文本次已重新確認，見 maintenance），保固完整支撐售價。confidence medium：有一筆里程完全相同的真實純電掛牌，且分母獨立可考；扣分處在於仍需跨車型（UX→ES）與跨級距兩層外推。

本次覆核**大幅下修**（原 850,000 / 745,000）。Reviewer 指原值 33.5% 高於同車系入門版 ES500e 頂級版的 30.2%，違反「高階款保值率略低」且未附反超理由——指摘成立，且本次重查未找到任何反超理由（旗艦版專屬的 Mark Levinson、AVS、21 吋鋁圈在台灣中古市場不但不加價，AVS 與大鋁圈反而因維修成本被殺價；本車 2026 年式產量亦非稀少，發表會即公布預接單近 1,000 張、年販目標 3,000 台）。因此改為下修至頂級版之下。

7 年點的真實掛牌錨（8891 本次逐筆重新擷取，現行世代無 7 年車，改用前代第 7 代 ES 的真實行情推算保值率再套回本車，屬明示外推）：2019 年式 ES300h 旗艦版 8.94 萬公里 1,069,000、8.97 萬公里 1,069,000、10.9 萬公里 1,088,000、11 萬公里 1,039,000；分母 2,350,000（2018-10 上市價）→ 車商零售 44.2-46.3%。**級距對照改用分母已本次獨立驗證的一組**（https://www.carstuff.com.tw/car-news/item/26460-167-200-lexus-es200-250.html 本次成功擷取並逐字確認 ES250 頂級版 1,990,000、旗艦版 2,190,000）：2018 年式 ES250 旗艦版 6.72 萬公里 939,000 → 42.9%；2018 年式 ES250 頂級版 5.21 萬公里 898,000（SUM）→ 45.1%。**同年式、同動力、旗艦版里程還高 15,000 公里的情況下，旗艦版仍比頂級版低 2.2 個百分點**，若拉到同里程差距更大。這是本記錄 7 年級距懲罰取 5.2 個百分點的實證基礎（取比 2.2 更寬，因為本車的級距價差 450,000 遠大於 ES250 兩級距的 200,000）。

推導：ES500e 頂級版 7 年車商零售等值 715,000 / 2,050,000 = 34.9%，扣 5.2 個百分點得 29.7% × 2,500,000 = 742,500 車商零售 → 自售 −11.8% = 655,000 → 車商收購再 −15.3% = 555,000。對 real_cost 保值率 25.8%，**低於頂級版的 30.2%**，反超問題消除。5→7 年的斜率（−13.0 個百分點 / 2 年）刻意大於 3→5 年（−11.0 / 2 年），理由是第 8 年 / 16 萬公里的動力電池保證在本案以「年」到期（7,000 km/年永遠碰不到 16 萬公里上限），市場提前一到兩年把電池風險折進價格——這與同車系頂級版該筆的處理方式相同，兩筆記錄因此同形。誠實註記：以上皆為**車商掛牌價（asking）非成交價**，台灣無公開成交價資料庫；成交價一般再低於掛牌，本記錄已透過「掛牌 → 自售 −11.8% → 收購 −15.3%」的價格鏈把這段吃掉。confidence low：跨世代與跨動力兩層外推。

本次覆核下修（原 460,000 / 400,000），並修正前次覆核的兩處事實錯誤。**最有價值的發現**：8891 上確實存在一筆里程與車齡都幾乎正中本檢查點的真實掛牌——**2016 年式 ES300h 旗艦版、6 萬公里、車商售價 628,000**（本次重新擷取確認）。前次覆核把它記成「2015 年式、六筆」，兩點都錯：它是 2016 年式（2026 年正好 10 年車）、且是單筆，不是六筆。修正後這筆的價值反而更高，因為它是**同為 10 年車、同為旗艦版、同為低里程（60,000 vs 本案 70,000）**的直接對照。分母 2,270,000（2015-09 小改款 ES300h 旗艦版）→ **628,000 / 2,270,000 = 27.7% 車商零售保值率**。高里程對照：同年式 19 萬公里僅 485,000 = 21.4%，2015 年式 13 萬公里 618,000 = 27.2%，顯示低里程在此車齡仍有明顯溢價。

10 年級距懲罰的實測（8891，同年式同動力，本次擷取）：2016 年式 ES200 頂級版 9 萬公里 658,000（分母 1,790,000）= 36.8%；2016 年式 ES200 旗艦版 8 萬公里 608,000（分母 1,990,000）= 30.6%。**旗艦版比頂級版低 6.2 個百分點，且里程還更低。** 這是全曲線最大的級距差，證實「配備溢價到 10 年幾乎完全歸零、甚至因維修顧慮轉為負值」。

推導：ES500e 頂級版 10 年車商零售等值 455,000 / 2,050,000 = 22.2%，扣級距懲罰後取 19.2% × 2,500,000 = 480,000 車商零售 → 自售 −11.5% = 425,000 → 車商收購再 −15.3% = 360,000。對 real_cost 保值率 16.8%，低於頂級版的 19.2%；絕對金額 425,000 仍高於頂級版的 400,000（10 年時兩級距的絕對價幾乎收斂，與上述 ES200 實測配對一致，該配對的旗艦版絕對價甚至已略低於頂級版）。純電對油電的折價在此為 19.2/27.7 = 0.69 倍，與 7 年點的 0.65 倍同量級——刻意不讓折價在 7 年後繼續複利加深，因為純電懲罰在第 8 年電池保證到期時已一次反映完畢。

斜率檢查（回應 reviewer 對「先寫好 10y 再回填中間」的質疑）：本曲線對 real_cost 的保值率為 67.1 → 49.9 → 38.9 → 25.8 → 16.8，年化跌幅 −8.6 / −5.5 / −6.5 / −3.0。尾段年化跌幅最小、無崩塌；5→7 的小幅加速有具名成因（電池保證懸崖）而非平滑誤差。與同車系 ES500e 頂級版（70.0 → 53.2 → 43.6 → 30.2 → 19.2）逐段比較，兩者形狀幾乎重合、僅差級距懲罰，這正是同一車系兩個級距該有的關係。confidence low：台灣不存在 10 年車齡的豪華純電房車二手市場，跨世代與跨動力兩層外推；下檔風險最大，若屆時電池需更換，實際可能遠低於此數。誠實註記：分母 2,270,000 與 1,790,000 / 1,990,000 來自 2015-09 U-CAR 價目表，**本次覆核 u-car.com.tw 全站回 403，該分母未能重新驗證**，屬沿用前次覆核結果。

maintenance.plan_notes:
**本次覆核重建了整段保養（原 10 年合計 328,000 → 現 389,000）。** Reviewer 指出原數字若不含大輪圈／煞車耗材的理由，兩個 ES500e 車型的保養應該幾乎相同——查核後發現問題比這更嚴重：原記錄的 328,000 不但沒有反映旗艦版的額外成本，反而**低於**同車系 ES500e 頂級版的 341,000，方向完全相反。成因是原記錄把前兩期（1 年 6,000、3 年 16,000）壓得過低，與頂級版同一套官方保養表下的 11,000 / 30,000 不一致——同動力、同保養表、前 3 年沒有任何旗艦版專屬耗材到期，這兩期本來就應該一模一樣。

**修正原則：例行保養與頂級版逐項對齊，只有真正屬於旗艦版的兩個項目才加價，並逐筆標出金額。**

官方制度（本次全部重新擷取確認）：
- 保養節點「每半年或 1 萬公里」，7,000 km/年 → 時間驅動、每年 2 次（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx）。
- 純電消耗品僅：冷氣濾網、煞車油（每 2 年或 4 萬公里）、加熱器冷卻液（首次 16 萬公里）、動力控制單元冷卻液（首次 24 萬公里）。無引擎機油、機油濾芯、火星塞、空氣濾芯、變速箱油。兩種冷卻液在 10 年 7 萬公里內都不到期。
- 免費項目只有交車後 1 個月的「滿月保養」（24 項），**Lexus Taiwan 沒有多年份免費定期保養方案**（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx 本次重新確認，該頁未描述任何免費或預付套餐）。因此 1 年與 3 年兩期一律以全額自費計。
- 保證：新車 3 年 / 10 萬公里原廠 + 1 年 / 2 萬公里總代理 = 合計 4 年 / 12 萬公里；動力電池 8 年 / 16 萬公里且容量不低於 70%（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/bev.aspx）。
- 延長保證：本次逐字重新確認官方原文——準時（每半年內）回廠定保者「即享第 5 年 / 14 萬公里之免費延長保證」，漏一次即喪失資格（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx）。本模型假設車主準時回廠，故**保固實際覆蓋到第 5 年**，第 6 年起才完全無原廠保證。同頁另確認 12V 電瓶保證 3 年、輪胎保證 3 年。

**旗艦版專屬的兩個成本推手（這是 reviewer 要求寫明的理由）：**
1. **21 吋胎 vs 19 吋胎。** 本次覆核首次把兩個尺寸放在同一查價基礎上比對：235/45 R21（旗艦版）在台灣輪胎行完工價每條 10,550-12,664（Michelin Pilot Sport 5 Energy / Pilot Sport EV / PS4 SUV），四條約 45,600，加定位約 48,000（https://biggo.com.tw/s/235%2F45R21/）；235/55 R19（頂級版）同基礎的四條完工價組合僅 29,031-30,600（Michelin Pilot Sport 5 Energy 電動車專用 29,031、PS4 SUV 29,419、Continental UX7 30,600），加定位約 32,000（https://biggo.com.tw/s/235%2F55R19/）。**單次換胎旗艦版多 16,000，10 年兩套多 34,000。**
2. **AVS 可變阻尼避震系統。** 旗艦版專屬、頂級版沒有，本次已由官方新聞稿獨立確認（https://www.lexus.com.tw/news_detail.aspx?nw=753）。AVS 為電子控制阻尼單元，10 年車齡的整修／更換遠貴於一般避震器：頂級版該筆記錄在 7-10 年編列一般懸吊襯套與避震器整理 25,000，本記錄改編 55,000，**多 30,000**；另在 5-7 年多編 3,000 作為保固外的 AVS 診斷與感知器風險。

合計旗艦版比頂級版多 67,000（輪胎 34,000 + AVS 33,000），這就是 389,000 與 341,000 的差額來源，可逐項對帳。2,235 kg 的雙馬達四驅車配 21 吋胎，10 年約需兩套胎（35,000 公里未磨穿，但 5-6 年橡膠老化到期，屬時間驅動更換）。純電車靠動能回收，煞車來令片壽命遠長於燃油車，但台灣濕度下低使用率反而讓碟盤鏽蝕，故在 7-10 年編列全車碟盤／來令片更換。

誠實註記：金額為依官方保養項目表、官方保證條件與實際查得的輪胎完工價自行組建的推估，**不是車主收據**；Mobile01 車主帳單討論串在本次擷取仍回 403，無法取得實付金額，因此除第 1 年外 confidence 皆為 low。另註：輪胎規格 235/45 R21 / 235/55 R19 來自前次覆核的 U-CAR 規格表，該頁本次回 403 未能重新驗證；若旗艦版實際非 21 吋，上述輪胎差額 34,000 需重算，AVS 的 33,000 則不受影響（已由官方新聞稿獨立確認）。10 年合計 389,000。

checkpoints.source: 涵蓋 3-5 年。此區間的主成本是第一套輪胎，也是旗艦版與頂級版第一次分岔。組成：四次全額自費回廠約 15,000、21 吋胎四條含工與定位 48,000、12V AGM 電瓶 9,000、煞車油 3,500、冷氣濾網／雨刷／定位約 8,400、零星約 4,100。**輪胎價格為本次覆核實際查得的完工價**：235/45 R21 每條 10,550-12,664（Michelin Pilot Sport 5 Energy / Pilot Sport EV / PS4 SUV，https://biggo.com.tw/s/235%2F45R21/），四條 45,600 + 定位 2,500 ≒ 48,000；同一查價基礎下頂級版的 235/55 R19 四條完工價組合僅 29,031-30,600（https://biggo.com.tw/s/235%2F55R19/），加定位約 32,000 —— **旗艦版此次換胎多付 16,000，這是 reviewer 要求寫明的大輪圈成本理由。** 更換時點為時間驅動而非磨耗驅動：35,000 公里胎紋尚足，但 2,235 kg 四驅車的 5 年份橡膠已老化，且原廠輪胎保證僅 3 年（https://www.lexus.com.tw/service/warranty.aspx）。12V 電瓶官方保證亦僅 3 年，台灣氣候下 3-5 年更換為常態。本區間仍受「準時定保 → 免費第 5 年 / 14 萬公里延長保證」覆蓋（官方原文本次已重新確認），故不編列保固外維修。輪胎與電瓶時點為判斷值。跨記錄註記：同車系 ES500e 頂級版該筆把 19 吋整組列 50,000，高於本次查得的 29,031-30,600 完工價；若兩筆改用同一查價基礎，兩者會一起下修，但 21 吋較 19 吋多 16,000 的差額不變。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the TW average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Midpoint 7,000 km/year used at every checkpoint (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). Two consequences drive this record. (1) Servicing is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven: verified on Toyota TW's own owner page, T30 is 'every 6 months or 10,000 km', T50 'every odd year or every 40,000 km starting at 20,000 km', T60 'every even year or every 40,000 km starting at 40,000 km'. At 7,000 km/year the calendar clock binds at essentially every visit, so the owner still makes 2 dealer visits per year. CORRECTION vs the prior draft, which claimed the mileage triggers are 'never reached': the T50 ladder starts at 20,000 km and repeats at 60,000 km, both of which this owner DOES pass (year 3 and ~year 8.5). It changes nothing about the visit count, because the odd-year clock lands first or at the same time, but the earlier statement was factually wrong and is corrected here. Consumables that age out rather than wear out (tires, 12V battery, brake fluid, coolant) dominate; wear items (pads, discs) are pushed far out, helped further by hybrid regenerative braking. (2) At every age this car carries roughly half the mileage of the average listing, so it should transact above the mileage-blind market average; low-mileage comparables were selected deliberately and named in each source string. Not a BEV, so no home-charger cost applies and no BEV-specific treatment (price cuts, battery-health discounting, faster tire wear) is relevant. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded by design, as are fuel and parking.

The same page was re-queried for grade-level detail and confirms 尊爵 = 前輪傳動 (FWD) with Auto LSD, 2,487 c.c., 17吋五幅式鋁圈, and that 尊爵+ and 旗艦 move to 18-inch wheels while PHEV is 20-inch E-Four 4WD. purchase.notes: Full trim label: RAV4 HYBRID 尊爵, 2WD front-drive with Auto LSD, 2,487 cc hybrid, 17-inch five-spoke alloys (trim field shortened to stay under the display-label limit). The English gloss 'Prestige' used in the prior draft is dropped: Toyota TW publishes the grade as 尊爵 and does not consistently market an English name for it, so asserting one added an unsourced claim. IMPORTANT CONTEXT: this is an ALL-NEW generation. The Toyota TW spec page is dated 2026/06/15 and applies to RAV4 produced from June 2026 onward, and the lineup is now hybrid/PHEV only with no gasoline grade, so the car has been on sale in Taiwan roughly 2 months as of 2026-08-12. That timing is why the discount is set LOW at NT$20,000. Real deal sheets show Toyota TW discount behaviour across a model's life cycle: a 2022 RAV4 HYBRID 旗艦 (list NT$1,200,000) transacted at NT$1,155,000 including NT$5,000 of accessories, i.e. about NT$50,000 off early in the cycle — this one was re-opened and re-read during the fact-check and the numbers check out; by 2024 the same 旗艦 (list NT$1,260,000) got NT$160,000 off at run-out; a 2020年式 2.0 旗艦 (list NT$1,206,000) got NT$140,000. A brand-new generation in its launch quarter, with an order backlog, gets far less — and what dealers do give tends to be accessories rather than cash. NT$20,000 cash is the realistic figure today; a buyer waiting 2-3 years into this generation should expect NT$80,000-150,000 instead. onroad_fees NT$45,000 = 領牌+代辦 ~NT$6,000 (a 2019 deal sheet showed NT$4,000 for 領牌; inflated to 2026) + typical 配件 pack ~NT$39,000 (隔熱紙 ~15,000, 行車紀錄器 ~8,000, 腳踏墊/門檻/踏板 ~6,000, 晴雨窗 ~3,000, 鍍膜 ~7,000). real_cost = 1,170,000 - 20,000 + 45,000 = 1,195,000, arithmetic re-checked. Warranty confirmed on the same official page: vehicle 4 years or 120,000 km; HYBRID system 5 years or 120,000 km; HYBRID battery 8 years or 160,000 km (2019 model year and newer) — at 7,000 km/year this owner never reaches any mileage cap, so all three are effectively pure time warranties for them.

selling_costs.notes: Private-sale scenario. 過戶 government fee is small (~NT$900) but almost everyone pays an agent to handle 監理站 paperwork, so NT$2,500 all-in. Pre-sale detailing on a mid-size SUV that has been well kept runs NT$5,000-8,000; NT$6,000 assumed. Listing fees on 8891/SUM for a private seller are ~NT$1,500-2,500. Total NT$10,500 sits in the middle of the 4,000-15,000 band, appropriate for this class. Reviewed and left unchanged by the fact-check. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer, these costs mostly vanish — but so does the private-sale premium, which is the larger effect; that trade-off is why both price columns are given at each checkpoint.

value_checkpoints.source: SUM 汽車網 RAV4 油電 listings, INDEPENDENTLY RE-FETCHED by this fact-check on 2026-08-12 (https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch.php?v=4&brand=TOYOTA&model=RAV4&q=油電); all 23 listings the prior draft cited were found verbatim on the live page, so no fabrication. Low-mileage near-new comparables: 2025 @12,884 km asking NT$1,059,000; 2026 @9,778 km asking NT$1,198,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN (the dealer-retail trap, handled explicitly): both are 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asks) on the outgoing XA50 旗艦, whose list was ~NT$1,260,000-1,300,000, so ~81-84% of list at dealer retail at 1 year with low mileage. Applied 83% to this car's NT$1,170,000 list = ~NT$971,000 dealer retail equivalent; then -10% to reach 自售價 (private sale) = NT$870,000; then a further -13% to reach 車商收購價 (dealer trade-in) = NT$760,000. Verified by the fact-check as a genuine private-sale figure, not a copied dealer ask. Only 7,000 km supports the top of the range, and the launch-period order backlog on the new generation props up year-1 values because buyers pay to skip the wait.

SUM 汽車網 listings re-fetched 2026-08-12 (same URL). Comparables confirmed present on the live page: 2024 @38,525 km asking NT$938,000 (2 yr); 2023 @34,906 km asking NT$919,000 (3 yr, 4WD 特仕). ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: these are dealer RETAIL asks. Against XA50 旗艦 list of ~NT$1,260,000-1,330,000 they imply ~69-74% of list, interpolating to ~70% at 3 years; our car's 21,000 km is well under these comparables' ~35,000 km, so +1-2 pts gives 72%. 0.72 x NT$1,170,000 = ~NT$842,000 dealer retail equivalent; -12% for private sale = NT$740,000; -13% again for dealer trade-in = NT$645,000. FACT-CHECK NOTE: 72% sits at the OPTIMISTIC end of the 69-74% band the real listings support; it is retained rather than trimmed because the mileage advantage is genuine and large, but a reader should treat this checkpoint as the top of a range, not a midpoint. Still inside the 4-year vehicle warranty here, which supports the price.

REVISED DOWN by this fact-check (was NT$670,000 / NT$585,000). SUM 汽車網 listings re-fetched 2026-08-12 (same URL). Verified comparables: 2021 @38,000 km asking NT$750,000 (the closest low-mileage match, and closest on mileage to our 35,000 km); 2022 @16,649 km asking NT$799,000 (4 yr, the single lowest-mileage older car in the pool). ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: these are dealer RETAIL asks. Against the XA50 旗艦 list of NT$1,200,000 — a figure CONFIRMED from a real 2022 PTT deal sheet re-read during this fact-check — the 2021 @38,000 km implies 62.5% of list at 5 years and the 2022 @16,649 km implies 66.6% at 4 years. The prior draft applied 65% at 5 years, which is above what its own cited comparable supports; corrected to 63%. 0.63 x NT$1,170,000 = ~NT$737,000 dealer retail equivalent; -11% private sale = NT$655,000; -13% dealer trade-in = NT$570,000. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED to low: the SUM result table exposes only year/mileage/price, so the TRIM of the 2021 @38,000 km car could not be confirmed. If it is a 旗艦 (list 1,200,000) the ratio is 62.5% as used; if it is a lower 尊爵-class grade (list ~1,100,000) the ratio would be ~68% and this checkpoint would be roughly NT$50,000 too low. The adjustment is deliberately modest because that ambiguity cuts both ways.

EXTRAPOLATED from the PREDECESSOR generation — the current generation only went on sale in Taiwan in mid-2026, so no genuine 7-year data for it can exist, and none is invented here. Real XA50 RAV4 Hybrid listings re-verified on the live SUM page 2026-08-12: 2019 @71,269 km asking NT$660,000; 2019 @128,461 km asking NT$688,000; 2019 @131,971 km asking NT$628,000 (a 2019 @126,509 km at NT$868,000 discarded as an outlier). FACT-CHECK NOTE: the prior draft also cited a '2019 @50,879 km asking NT$698,000' which does NOT appear on the 油電 query page; it presumably came from the separate HYBRID query and could not be re-verified here, so this checkpoint now rests on the 2019 @71,269 km at NT$660,000, which IS verified. Smoothing to a lower-mileage 7-year example (ours has 49,000 km) gives ~NT$685,000 dealer RETAIL. Expressed as a retention ratio of that car's original list (~NT$1,180,000 for the 2019 XA50 Hybrid 旗艦, itself INFERRED by interpolating the confirmed 2022 figure of NT$1,200,000 backwards) that is ~58%. Applying it to this car's list gives ~NT$682,000 dealer retail equivalent; -12% private sale = NT$600,000; -13% dealer trade-in = NT$520,000. Confidence LOW: cross-generation extrapolation resting on an inferred historical list price. Note the 5-to-7-year stretch is deliberately flat, which the real data supports — TW used prices plateau in the 5-8 year band before falling away near 10 years.

REVISED DOWN by this fact-check (was NT$425,000 / NT$365,000). EXTRAPOLATED from the generation BEFORE last (XA40 RAV4 HYBRID 尊爵版 — usefully the identical trim name). Real listings re-verified on the live SUM pages 2026-08-12: 2016 @90,155 km asking NT$439,000 (10 yr); 2016 @190,533 km asking NT$368,000; 2017 @52,727 km asking NT$478,000 (9 yr, low mileage); 2017 @95,000 km asking NT$488,000; 2017 @121,420 km asking NT$438,000; 2017 @127,096 km asking NT$448,000. A 10-year car at 70,000 km sits between the verified 2016 @90,155 km (NT$439,000) and the 2017 @52,727 km (NT$478,000), i.e. ~NT$455,000-470,000 dealer RETAIL in today's money. The prior draft's ratio route (41% of an ASSUMED ~NT$1,100,000 XA40 list, applied to NT$1,170,000) produced NT$480,000 dealer retail equivalent, which is 3-5% above what the direct comparables support; the two methods are split here at ~NT$470,000. -11.5% private sale = NT$415,000; -13% dealer trade-in = NT$360,000. Confidence LOW: two-generation extrapolation, and the XA40 Hybrid 尊爵 list price could NOT be verified from any primary source (no web-search budget remained; U-CAR and 8891 were unreachable in the prior pass). Two offsetting effects were considered and left to cancel: modern hybrids should hold up better than XA40-era ones (hybrid-battery fear has faded and the battery is warranted 8 years/160,000 km), but this car's higher list price depreciates proportionally harder in Taiwan.

maintenance.plan_notes: Intervals are OFFICIAL and were RE-VERIFIED by this fact-check on Toyota Taiwan's own owner page (https://www.toyota.com.tw/owner_maintenance.aspx): T30 every 6 months or 10,000 km (機油 + 機油濾清器 + 放油塞墊片, 30+ inspection points); T50 every ODD year or every 40,000 km STARTING AT 20,000 km (oil + filter plus periodic parts — air filter, spark plugs, brake fluid, coolant — and 50+ inspections); T60 every EVEN year or every 40,000 km STARTING AT 40,000 km (oil + filter plus fuel filter and engine coolant, 60+ inspections). TWO CORRECTIONS vs the prior draft. (a) It claimed 'the 40,000 km triggers are never reached'. Not true: the T50 ladder begins at 20,000 km and repeats at 60,000 km, and this owner passes both (year 3 and ~year 8.5). The conclusion is unaffected — the calendar clock binds first or simultaneously, so the visit count is the same — but the statement was wrong. (b) It put brake fluid and coolant in T60; the official page lists brake fluid and coolant under T50, with fuel filter and engine coolant under T60. AT 7,000 KM/YEAR THE SCHEDULE IS EFFECTIVELY TIME-DRIVEN and the owner makes 2 dealer visits per year: one T30 at the 6-month point plus one T50 (odd years) or T60 (even years) at the 12-month point. Roughly NT$3,000 per T30, NT$6,000 per T50, NT$10,000 per T60, i.e. ~NT$9,000 in odd years and ~NT$13,000 in even years. PRICES ARE ESTIMATES, NOT SOURCED: Toyota Taiwan explicitly does NOT publish package prices ('如欲獲得保養套餐內容與價格費用之詳細資訊，請洽 TOYOTA 全台服務廠' — confirmed still true on the live page), and no owner receipt thread could be retrieved. Treat the interval structure as high confidence and the money as an estimate at typical 和泰 dealer rates. There is a known DOWNWARD bias risk on the money: several parts inside T50/T60 (spark plugs, fuel filter) are really mileage-gated, and at 70,000 km in ten years this car may never need them, so the true bill could run below these figures. NO FREE SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE PROGRAMME applies — Toyota TW does not run one comparable to Volvo TW's; only the customary free 1,000 km first check is included. Warranty, confirmed on the official spec page: vehicle 4 years/120,000 km, HYBRID system 5 years/120,000 km, HYBRID battery 8 years/160,000 km. Because this owner never approaches any mileage cap, repair risk is essentially zero through year 4, hybrid-drive risk zero through year 5, and traction-battery risk zero through year 8 — which is why out-of-warranty contingencies appear only in the 5-7 and 7-10 windows. The 尊爵 rides on 17-inch alloys (verified on the official spec page; 尊爵+ and 旗艦 are 18-inch), so tires are materially cheaper than the upper grades.

checkpoints.source: REVISED UP by this fact-check (was NT$4,000). Interval structure from the official Toyota TW maintenance table (https://www.toyota.com.tw/owner_maintenance.aspx), re-verified 2026-08-12. The prior draft counted only ONE paid T30 in year 1, which contradicts its own plan_notes and its own year-3 figure: it asserts 2 paid dealer visits every year and then bills the 1-3y window at NT$24,000 for 4 visits (NT$12,000/yr), while billing year 1 at NT$4,000. On the official time-driven schedule year 1 contains a free 1,000 km check, a T30 at 6 months (~NT$3,000) and a T50 at 12 months (~NT$6,000), plus ~NT$1,000 of consumables = ~NT$10,000. Time-driven — at 7,000 km the 10,000 km trigger is not reached. Fully inside the 4-year vehicle warranty, so zero repair risk. Prices estimated at typical 和泰 dealer rates; Toyota TW does not publish them.

major_items: 4 次定保 over 2 years (2x T30, plus one T60 in year 2 and one T50 in year 3)
冷氣濾網 / 空氣濾芯 (cabin and air filters)
煞車油 (brake fluid) — time-based, in the T50 package
水箱精 (coolant) 檢查/更換

checkpoints.source: Official interval table, re-verified 2026-08-12; unchanged by the fact-check. 2 visits/year x 2 years = 4 visits = NT$3,000 + NT$13,000 (year 2, T30 + T60) + NT$3,000 + NT$6,000 (year 3, T30 + T50) less overlap = ~NT$22,000, plus ~NT$2,000 sundries. Prices estimated at typical 和泰 dealer rates (Toyota TW does not publish them). Entire window inside the 4-year vehicle warranty, so no repair allowance is included. No tires or brakes yet — 21,000 km is far too low for wear and the tires are not yet old enough to age out. Note this window does pass the T50 20,000 km marker, but the odd-year clock lands at the same visit so it adds no cost.

major_items: 4 次定保 over 2 years (2x T30 + one T60 in year 4 + one T50 in year 5) ~NT$22,000
第一次換胎: 原廠 17吋 四條全換 ~NT$22,000 — AGED OUT, not worn out (only ~35,000 km, but rubber is 5 years old)
12V 輔助電瓶 (hybrid auxiliary battery) ~NT$6,000
煞車油/水箱精 on the T50 cycle (inside the 定保 figure)
checkpoints.source: Official interval table for the servicing, re-verified 2026-08-12; unchanged by the fact-check. Consumables timed by AGE not mileage, which is the defining feature of this low-mileage profile. Tires: a 17-inch RAV4 fitment in TW runs ~NT$18,000-24,000 for a mid-range set of four; NT$22,000 assumed — a 5-year-old tire is replaced on age regardless of tread depth. Hybrid 12V auxiliary battery typically lasts 4-6 years, ~NT$5,000-8,000. The 4-year vehicle warranty expires inside this window and the 5-year hybrid-system warranty expires at its end, so a small residual risk sits here; no explicit contingency was added because the exposure is only a few months. Prices estimated, not from receipts.

major_items: 4 次定保 over 2 years (2x T30 + one T60 + one T50) ~NT$22,000
前輪煞車來令片 (front brake pads) ~NT$7,000 — delayed well past normal by regenerative braking
雨刷/電瓶檢測/小保養雜項 ~NT$4,000
Out-of-warranty contingency ~NT$20,000: 避震器四支、引擎腳、懸吊襯套、水幫浦、各式感知器
checkpoints.source: REVISED UP by this fact-check (was NT$42,000). The prior draft's figure BROKE MONOTONICITY — it billed the 5-7 year window (NT$42,000) BELOW the 3-5 year window (NT$50,000), even though 5-7 is the first window sitting fully OUTSIDE the 4-year vehicle warranty and, from year 5, outside the 5-year HYBRID system warranty. An out-of-warranty window costing less than an in-warranty one is not credible. The contingency is raised from NT$13,000 to NT$20,000, which is where a 6-7 year old TW SUV realistically lands once 避震器 (~NT$16,000-20,000 for four corners) enter the picture, and NT$4,000 of ordinary sundries is made explicit. Servicing base from the official interval table, re-verified 2026-08-12. The allowance is still kept moderate because RAV4 hybrids are mechanically durable, the car has only 49,000 km, and the traction battery is still covered to year 8. Brake pads at ~49,000 km are late by combustion standards; hybrid regen genuinely defers them. Prices estimated at typical dealer rates, not from receipts.

major_items: 6 次定保 over 3 years (3x T30 + T60/T50/T60 on the even/odd cycle) ~NT$35,000
第二次換胎 ~NT$22,000 — again aged out at ~5 years, not worn out
12V 輔助電瓶 second replacement ~NT$6,000
煞車碟盤 + 後來令片 (discs + rear pads) ~NT$12,000
水箱精 / 逆變器冷卻液 / eCVT 油 ~NT$5,000
Out-of-warranty contingency ~NT$27,000: 冷氣壓縮機、避震器、懸吊、發電機、各式感知器、橡膠件老化
checkpoints.source: Adjusted slightly by this fact-check (was NT$105,000) so the servicing base matches the corrected two-visits-per-year structure: years 8, 9 and 10 cost ~NT$13,000 + NT$9,000 + NT$13,000 = NT$35,000, not NT$33,000. Official interval table re-verified 2026-08-12, plus an ageing-vehicle allowance. Longest window (3 years) so the servicing base is larger. The HYBRID traction battery is warranted 8 years/160,000 km and this owner reaches only 70,000 km, so it is covered through year 8 and NO battery replacement is budgeted — but years 8-10 are uncovered, and a traction-battery failure would be a NT$150,000-250,000 event, which is the single largest tail risk in this record and is deliberately NOT averaged into the number. The NT$27,000 contingency covers ordinary out-of-warranty ageing only. Prices estimated at typical dealer rates, not from receipts. Confidence low.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; all checkpoints use 7,000 km/year (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). That is roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year, so every used-value figure here is taken from LOW-MILEAGE comparables rather than the mileage-blind average, and each source string says so. Toyota Taiwan's service interval is 'every 6 months or 10,000 km, whichever comes first' (verified on the Toyota TW Guidebook), so at 7,000 km/year this owner is entirely TIME-driven: 2 paid services per year regardless of distance. Low mileage therefore lifts resale value but does NOT reduce scheduled maintenance cost. PHEV-specific: with 135 km of EV range against roughly 19 km/day of driving, the engine accumulates very few hours, yet oil changes stay calendar-driven. HOME CHARGER EXCLUDED: a Taiwan home AC charger install runs roughly NT$20,000-40,000 and in an apartment needs 管委會 approval, which is often refused. That is a real ownership cost but it is not maintenance, so it is deliberately absent from maintenance.checkpoints. Note this cuts both ways on resale: unlike a BEV, a used RAV4 PHEV runs perfectly well on petrol alone, so a buyer without charger access loses the running-cost benefit but not the use of the car. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded by design throughout.

purchase.source: List price independently re-verified by me on two official Toyota Taiwan pages (showroom/RAV4/price.aspx and showroom/RAV4/spec.aspx), both returning NT$1,490,000 for the PHEV 4WD, alongside the Hybrid lineup at 1,040,000 / 1,170,000 / 1,220,000 / 1,300,000. My figure matches the prior researcher's exactly (0% difference), so list_price and real_cost are unchanged. This is the only high-confidence number in the record.
purchase.notes: Full designation: 2026 RAV4 PHEV 插電式油電車 E-Four 4WD, 2.5L plus twin motor, 189 ps engine / 329 ps combined, 22.7 kWh battery, 135 km EV range, 131.6 km/L equivalent. The 22.7 kWh / 329 ps combination identifies this as the all-new 6th-generation (XA60) RAV4, not the outgoing 5th-gen (XA50), whose PHEV used an 18.1 kWh pack and made about 302 ps. That distinction matters for the value curve: no 6th-gen car of any kind exists in the Taiwan used pool yet. DISCOUNTS (30,000, about 2%): Toyota Taiwan does discount, but this is a newly launched, allocation-limited variant sitting 190,000 above the top Hybrid Flagship at 1,300,000. The official page pushes FINANCING incentives (200,000 over 20 instalments at 0%, 300,000 over 30 instalments at 1.88%) rather than cash off the hood; the 0% loan is worth roughly NT$8,000-10,000 in avoided interest. I credit 30,000 total, blending that finance value with a small cash or accessory concession, deliberately far below the NT$50,000-80,000 commonly available on volume RAV4 Hybrid trims. ONROAD_FEES (50,000): 領牌費 and 監理規費 about 5,000; 代辦費 about 7,000; 配件 (隔熱紙, 行車記錄器, 腳踏墊, 鍍膜) about 38,000, scaled for a 1,490,000 vehicle. This is on the generous side of the plausible band; a buyer who skips coating and film would land nearer 35,000 total. Tax and insurance excluded by design. real_cost = 1,490,000 - 30,000 + 50,000 = 1,510,000.

selling_costs.notes: Priced at the upper-middle of the usual NT$4,000-15,000 band because this is a premium SUV around NT$1,490,000: buyers at this price point inspect closely, so paint correction and interior detailing at 6,500 genuinely pay for themselves. Transfer agent fee assumes the seller uses an agent rather than queueing at 監理站 personally. One PHEV-specific cost not included: a used-PHEV buyer will often want a battery health report, and a Toyota dealer diagnostic printout to support the asking price would add roughly NT$1,000-2,000. Left out because it is optional and not yet universal practice in Taiwan. Verified: items sum to exactly 11,000.

value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED - no RAV4 PHEV and no 6th-gen RAV4 exists in the Taiwan used pool (SUM 汽車網, 235 RAV4 listings across 3 pages read, zero PHEV, zero 6th-gen). CORRECTED DOWNWARD from a prior estimate of 1,240,000. Best available anchor is a RAV4 HYBRID rather than the gasoline 2.0 used previously: SUM lists a 2025 RAV4 油電旗艦特仕版, 12,884 km, dealer asking NT$1,059,000 against a 1,300,000 Hybrid Flagship list = 81.5% dealer-RETAIL retention at about 1 year, low mileage. Applying the dealer-retail to private markdown of ~10% gives ~73.5% private for the hybrid. I hold the PHEV at the same ~73.5% of its own list: the allocation-limited launch premium and RAV4 brand strength (Taiwan's best-selling SUV, real waiting lists) offset the immediate erosion of the 190,000 PHEV premium over the Hybrid Flagship. 1,490,000 x 73.5% = 1,095,000. Dealer trade-in a further 12.8% below = 955,000. The prior 1,240,000 (83% of list) was rejected because it implied the PHEV out-retains the cheaper plain RAV4 Hybrid, which no Taiwan evidence supports.

EXTRAPOLATED from low-mileage RAV4 HYBRID comps on SUM 汽車網: a 2023 RAV4 油電旗艦 4WD 特仕版, 34,906 km, dealer asking NT$919,000, and a 2024 RAV4 旗艦, 20,896 km, dealer asking NT$959,000. Against a ~1,300,000 Hybrid Flagship list these are ~70.7% dealer-RETAIL at 3 years and ~73.8% at 2 years. Applying the ~10% dealer-retail to private markdown gives ~63.6% private at 3 years for the hybrid. I deduct ~3.5 points for the PHEV, reflecting erosion of the 190,000 plug-in premium among buyers who cannot install a charger, giving ~60.4% -> 1,490,000 x 60.4% = 900,000. Dealer trade-in 12.8% below = 785,000. Still inside both warranties (HV system 5 years / 120,000 km, drive battery 8 years / 160,000 km), which supports the price. CORRECTED DOWNWARD from 1,000,000.

EXTRAPOLATED from XA50 low-mileage comps on SUM 汽車網: a 2021 RAV4 2500cc hybrid, 77,957 km, dealer asking NT$768,000, and a 2021 gasoline trim, 29,736 km, asking NT$719,000. Against a ~1,210,000 XA50 hybrid list the 2021 hybrid is ~63.5% dealer retail at 5 years but at 2.2x this buyer's mileage; adding a low-mileage premium of roughly 8% lifts it to ~68% dealer retail, and the ~10% private markdown gives ~61% private for a low-mileage hybrid. I deduct ~9 points for the PHEV to ~51.7% -> 1,490,000 x 51.7% = 770,000. Dealer trade-in 13.0% below = 670,000. The PHEV deduction widens here because the HV system warranty (5 years / 120,000 km) expires on TIME at exactly this checkpoint for a low-mileage owner, while the drive-battery warranty still has 3 years to run; buyers price that split. CORRECTED DOWNWARD from 830,000.

EXTRAPOLATED via PREDECESSOR-GENERATION RATIO - no 7-year data can exist for a generation launched in 2026. Predecessor = XA40 RAV4 (Taiwan 2013-2018). Real SUM listings: 2018 with 98,677 km asking NT$498,000 and 2018 with 103,893 km asking NT$518,000, against a ~889,000 original list = ~56% dealer-RETAIL retention at 8 years, but at roughly double this buyer's 49,000 km. Adding a ~12% low-mileage premium and interpolating back to 7 years gives ~65% dealer retail; the ~10% private markdown gives ~58% of that car's original list. Applied to THIS car's list of 1,490,000 that implies ~865,000 on a petrol-equivalent basis. I then apply a 26% PHEV and price-band deduction -> 640,000 (43.0% of list). The deduction covers three things: the HV system warranty expired at year 5, the drive battery warranty is in its final year, and a 1,490,000 car converges toward the same absolute used-price band as cheaper rivals at this age. This replaces a prior 20% penalty applied on top of an already-optimistic base; the net effect is a modest downward correction from 700,000. Explicitly extrapolated, not observed.

EXTRAPOLATED via PREDECESSOR-GENERATION RATIO. Best real anchor on SUM 汽車網: a 2015 XA40 RAV4, 78,000 km, dealer asking NT$358,000 - an unusually close mileage match, since this buyer reaches 70,000 km at year 10 and that car is 11 years old with 78,000 km. Against a ~849,000 original list that is ~42% dealer-RETAIL retention; interpolating back to 10 years gives ~46% dealer retail, and the ~10% private markdown gives ~41% of that car's original list, i.e. about 322,000 in absolute private-sale money. Applying the 41% ratio to this car's list of 1,490,000 gives ~611,000 on a petrol-equivalent basis; I then deduct 28% for the PHEV and price-band effects -> 440,000 (29.5% of list). Cross-check on absolute money: 440,000 is about 37% above the XA40 comp's implied private price, which is the right order for a much newer-generation, better-equipped AWD car. The deduction reflects the 8-year / 160,000 km drive-battery warranty having expired two years earlier and a 22.7 kWh pack costing far more to replace than a conventional hybrid pack. I deliberately did NOT use the prior 30% penalty stacked on an optimistic base; the corrected figure is slightly ABOVE the prior 430,000 because the base was rebuilt on hybrid rather than gasoline comps. Explicitly extrapolated, not observed.

maintenance.plan_notes: NO free scheduled-maintenance programme - verified on the official RAV4 showroom page, which describes 愛車養護與保證 but names no complimentary service intervals. Toyota Taiwan sells maintenance as a paid dealer service. The only confirmed freebies on the Toyota TW Guidebook are the 滿月檢查 (free one-month inspection) and free LABOUR on the first half-year service; parts are still billed. INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN FOR THIS BUYER: the official interval is every 6 months or 10,000 km, whichever comes first. At 7,000 km/year the mileage trigger is never reached first, so this owner pays for 2 services every year - 20 services across only 70,000 km - and mileage-based savings never materialise. Genuine parts carry a 1 year / 20,000 km warranty. Vehicle warranties that shape the later windows, both verified on the RAV4 showroom page: HYBRID system (battery, converter, control modules, motor) = 5 years / 120,000 km; HYBRID drive battery = 8 years / 160,000 km for 2019 model year onward. PHEV COST SHAPE: brakes last unusually long because regenerative braking does most of the stopping, and the engine accumulates very few hours since 135 km of EV range covers nearly all of this owner's ~19 km/day, so front pads sit in the 5-7y window and discs in the 7-10y window on a TIME and heat-cycling basis rather than a wear basis. Working against that, the PHEV is roughly 300 kg heavier than the gasoline RAV4, so tyres and suspension bushings wear faster, and at this mileage tyres are replaced on RUBBER AGE (about 5-6 years), never tread depth - which is why two full tyre sets appear in a 10-year plan covering only 70,000 km. Total 10-year maintenance of 240,000 sits sensibly between a plain RAV4 Hybrid (lighter, smaller wheels, one coolant loop) and a Lexus PHEV (much higher dealer labour rates). Period costs are per-window, not cumulative, and exclude tax, insurance and home-charger installation. Note the year-7 window (40,000) is lower than year-5 (53,000); this is not an error but the tyre-replacement cycle landing inside the year-5 window.

checkpoints.source: Toyota TW Guidebook (https://www.toyota.com.tw/Guidebook/) - I re-verified this page directly and it confirms the 6-month / 10,000 km interval, the free 滿月檢查, the 首半年定保工資免費 labour waiver, and the 1 year / 20,000 km genuine-parts warranty. Cost built from that official interval structure plus typical Taiwan Toyota dealer pricing for a 2.5L hybrid on 0W-16 synthetic (about NT$3,000 for a minor service, NT$5,000 for a major one); the free first-service labour is what holds year 1 down to about 7,000. Toyota Taiwan publishes no per-item price list, so the money figure is inferred, not sourced.

checkpoints.source: Covers years 1-3 = 4 time-driven services at the official 6-month interval (Toyota TW Guidebook, verified), with no free labour remaining. Brake fluid is hygroscopic and replaced on a roughly 2-year schedule irrespective of mileage. All items remain inside the 5 year / 120,000 km HV system warranty and the 1 year / 20,000 km parts warranty, so no repair provision is included. Money figures are typical Taiwan dealer pricing, not receipts.

checkpoints.source: Years 3-5, dominated by two age-driven consumables unrelated to mileage. The original tyres reach 5 years old and are replaced on age with plenty of tread left (235/55R19, about NT$7,000 each fitted), and the 12V auxiliary battery typically fails at 4-5 years. The 12V is a genuine PHEV weak point: it is not the traction battery, it is a conventional small battery that boots the system, it is NOT covered by the 8-year traction-battery warranty, and it strands the car when it dies. Brake pads are deliberately excluded here because regenerative braking means 35,000 km of PHEV driving barely touches the friction material. Typical Taiwan dealer and tyre-shop pricing, not receipts.

前煞車來令片 + 碟盤整理
煞車油更換

checkpoints.source: Years 5-7, the first window carrying genuine out-of-warranty exposure. The HYBRID system warranty (5 years / 120,000 km, verified on the official Toyota TW RAV4 showroom page) expires on TIME at year 5 for this low-mileage owner; the 120,000 km limb is irrelevant at 49,000 km. From here, inverter water pump, DC-DC converter and HV sensor faults are billed to the owner, so a roughly 10,000 risk provision is included. The drive battery itself remains covered to year 8. Front pads appear here rather than earlier, on time and heat-cycling rather than wear. Extrapolated risk provisioning, not an observed repair cost, hence low confidence.

major_items: 6 次定期保養 (時間制, 3年)
第二次四條輪胎更換 (約 30,000)
冷卻液更換 - 引擎 + 逆變器兩迴路 (約 6,000)
火星塞 (時間制, 非里程制)
12V 電瓶第二次
煞車碟盤 + 後來令片
避震器/橡膠襯套老化
驅動電池保固第8年到期 - 風險預備金 約 20,000
checkpoints.source: Years 7-10, the longest window at 3 years and by far the most expensive. Three things stack: (1) a SECOND full tyre set on age at about year 10, since the year-5 set also times out long before 70,000 km wears it; (2) Toyota's roughly 10-year service items landing together - coolant on BOTH the engine and the inverter loop, since a PHEV has two cooling circuits, which is why this line is larger than on a combustion car, plus spark plugs replaced on time despite very few engine hours, brake discs, and perished suspension bushings; (3) the 8 year / 160,000 km DRIVE-BATTERY WARRANTY expiring at year 8, mid-window. That last point is the single largest uncertainty in this record: I provision only about 20,000 for degradation-related module work and HV ancillaries, NOT for a pack replacement, which would plausibly cost NT$300,000-500,000 and exceed the car's projected value at that age. Anyone using this table should treat years 8-10 as carrying a low-probability, very-high-severity tail risk deliberately not averaged into this number. Extrapolated from Toyota's published interval and warranty structure plus predecessor-generation service patterns; no 10-year RAV4 PHEV exists anywhere in Taiwan to observe.

sources.note: NEW SOURCE added by this fact-check, and the basis for the downward correction of the year-1 to year-5 values. Supplies low-mileage RAV4 HYBRID comparables that the prior research missed by anchoring on gasoline 2.0 cars: 2025 油電旗艦特仕版 12,884 km asking 1,059,000; 2024 旗艦 20,896 km asking 959,000; 2023 油電旗艦 4WD 特仕版 34,906 km asking 919,000; 2021 2500cc hybrid 77,957 km asking 768,000. A hybrid is a far closer analogue to a PHEV than a gasoline 2.0.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr; all checkpoints use 7,000 km/yr (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km) — roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr, so every used value here is a LOW-MILEAGE quote, not a mileage-blind average. Two consequences run through the model. (1) Resale: at 5 years this car shows 35,000 km while typical same-age TW listings show 60,000-110,000 km, so it sits at the top of its year's price band; low-mileage listings were used as anchors wherever they existed. (2) Maintenance: Toyota TW's interval is 10,000 km OR 6 months, whichever comes first, so at 7,000 km/yr the 6-month clock always fires first and servicing is time-driven — about 2 visits/year regardless of distance. Cost per km is therefore high (~NT$2.6/km) even though annual spend is moderate: you pay per visit, not per kilometre. Tax (牌照稅/燃料費), insurance and fuel are EXCLUDED by design (official economy is 16.3 km/L). Generation caveat driving the confidence ratings: the current Camry launched in Taiwan in July 2024 and is only ~2 years old, so genuine same-generation resale data exists only for years 1-2. Years 3, 5, 7 and 10 are extrapolated from predecessor generations, as stated in each checkpoint. METHOD NOTE (changed by fact-check): retention ratios derived from used price ÷ ORIGINAL LIST price are now applied to list_price (1,109,000), not to real_cost (1,114,000). real_cost includes on-road fees and a dealer accessory pack, which have essentially no resale value, so applying a list-derived ratio to real_cost overstates residuals.

purchase.source: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY by this fact-check: fetched Toyota Taiwan's own showroom spec page (toyota.com.tw/showroom/CAMRY/spec.aspx), which returns 汽油旗艦 NT$1,109,000, HYBRID尊爵 NT$1,129,000, HYBRID旗艦 NT$1,250,000, and 1,987cc / 171ps / 16.3 km/L for the gasoline car. Cross-checked against the model landing page (日本進口) and against cars.tvbs.com.tw/car-news/335700 (fetched, dated 2026-08-04), which confirms the current three-trim lineup at 110.9 / 112.9 / 125萬 and the removal of the NT$985,000 汽油豪華. List price is CORRECT, unchanged. Discount and on-road figures are market estimates, not quoted prices.
purchase.notes: Full trim name is 汽油旗艦 (Gasoline Premier), 2.0L / 1,987cc, 171ps, 16.3 km/L, 日本進口 — shortened to '汽油旗艦 2.0L' for display. Current generation launched in Taiwan July 2024 at NT$1,109,000; price has not moved since. Lineup change confirmed by the TVBS article: as of early August 2026 和泰 delisted the NT$985,000 汽油豪華, so 汽油旗艦 is now the ONLY gasoline trim and the entry Camry — i.e. within the gasoline line it is a base car, not a loaded top trim. discounts NT$40,000: Toyota TW does discount for cash, typically NT$30,000-50,000 on a Camry; middle of the band, shaded down because trimming the sub-million trim signals 和泰 is pushing the line upward rather than clearing stock. onroad_fees NT$45,000 = 領牌規費 + 代辦費 ~NT$10,000 plus a typical dealer accessory pack ~NT$35,000 (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 腳踏墊, 晴雨窗, 鍍膜). Tax (牌照稅, 燃料費) and insurance are EXCLUDED by design. real_cost = 1,109,000 - 40,000 + 45,000 = 1,114,000.

selling_costs.notes: Costs for a PRIVATE sale (自售), matching private_sale_price in the checkpoints. 過戶 itself is only a couple hundred NT$ in 規費; the rest is 代辦 if the seller does not want to queue at the 監理站. Pre-sale prep is the big item on a mid-large sedan — a low-mileage Camry still needs proper 美容/鍍膜 and minor scratch touch-up to reach the top of its price band. 刊登費 is 8891 個人刊登 with paid exposure. Total NT$10,500 sits mid-range for this class and inside the expected NT$4,000-15,000 band. If the owner trades in to a dealer instead (dealer_tradein_price), these costs mostly vanish — part of why the trade-in figure is lower.

value_checkpoints.source: GENUINE same-generation, same-trim data, RE-VERIFIED by this fact-check. I fetched auto.8891.com.tw/toyota/camry?price=500000_1000000 myself and confirmed the listing the original researcher cited: a 2026款 汽油旗艦 2.0L with ~7,000 km asking NT$968,000 — an almost exact match for this buyer's spec and mileage. Second anchor added by this fact-check (the original record missed it): a 2024 汽油旗艦 2.0L with 16,300 km asking NT$899,000, seen on three separate fetches of the 8891 Camry listings — same trim, same generation, 2 years old, 81.1% of list. The two points define the car's own early curve (87.3% at yr1, 81.1% at yr2). CORRECTION: the original record's second corroborator, a '2025 油電旗艦 with 10,000 km at NT$1,098,000', did NOT appear in any of my fetches (the closest hybrid listings were a 2023 Hybrid尊爵 at 22,000 km / NT$788,000 and a 2024 油電尊爵 at NT$900,000); it has been dropped. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: NT$968,000 is a DEALER RETAIL asking price (車商售價), not what an owner receives. Took 11% off for private sale (968,000 -> 861,000) and a further 13% for dealer trade-in (861,000 -> 749,000). Confidence stays high because the primary anchor is an observed listing of exactly this trim at exactly this mileage.

EXTRAPOLATED, but now from two methods that agree (the original record used only one, and mis-adjusted it). Method A — the car's own curve: verified same-trim listings give 87.3% of list at 1 year (2026 汽油旗艦, 7,000 km, NT$968,000) and 81.1% at 2 years (2024 汽油旗艦, 16,300 km, NT$899,000); continuing at ~-5.5pp/yr gives ~75.6% at year 3. Method B — predecessor ratio: a 2023 汽油尊爵 2.0L with 14,600 km asking NT$790,000 against a NT$1,029,000 list = 76.8% low-mileage dealer-asking retention at 3 years (listing re-verified by me on page 2 of the 8891 Camry results). The two converge on ~76%. CORRECTION vs the original record: it used 74%, shaving ~1-2pp because '旗艦 is the top trim and option content retains a lower percentage'. That contradicts its own finding that 和泰 delisted the 汽油豪華, leaving 汽油旗艦 as the ONLY gasoline trim and the entry Camry — the top-trim penalty does not apply and has been removed. Ratio is applied to list_price (1,109,000), not real_cost. 0.76 x 1,109,000 = NT$843,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -11.5% to private sale (843,000 -> 746,000), then -13% to dealer trade-in (746,000 -> 649,000). Higher-mileage 2023 listings in the same set (80,000 km / NT$658,000 and 120,000 km / NT$588,000) confirm this buyer's low mileage sits at the top of the band.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor generation at 5 years. Real 8891 listings for the 2021 Camry 汽油豪華 2.0L, all re-verified by me on page 2 of the Camry results: 59,000 km asking NT$578,000, 90,000 km asking NT$588,000, 107,800 km asking NT$509,000. Against a NT$929,000 list these are 62.2%, 63.3% and 54.8% — note the 59,000/90,000 km pair is internally inconsistent (the higher-mileage car asks more), which is why this checkpoint stays low confidence. Extrapolating along the mileage gradient (~1.5pp per 10,000 km) from the 59,000 km point down to this buyer's 35,000 km gives ~65.8%. Independent cross-check: a 2022 汽油豪華 2.0L with 64,000 km asking NT$628,000 = 67.6% at 4 years, which mileage-adjusts to ~73% at 28,000 km, and 73% at yr4 -> 66% at yr5 is a sensible -7pp step. Settled on 66%. CORRECTIONS vs the original record: (a) it used 64% after taking ~1pp off for '旗艦 being the top trim' — removed, since 汽油旗艦 is now the entry gasoline Camry; (b) the ratio is applied to list_price (1,109,000), not real_cost. 0.66 x 1,109,000 = NT$732,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% to private sale (732,000 -> 644,000), then -13.5% to dealer trade-in (644,000 -> 557,000). CONFIDENCE FIX: the original record's field said 'low' while its own source text argued 'medium' — resolved to low, which is correct: this rests on a mileage-gradient extrapolation from an internally inconsistent trio, it crosses a generation boundary, and the NT$929,000 denominator comes from a page that returns HTTP 403 and could not be read directly by either researcher.

EXTRAPOLATED across a generation boundary, and the two available anchors DISAGREE badly — stated openly rather than papered over. Anchor A (observed, pessimistic): the only real low-mileage 7-year-old Camrys on 8891 are a 2019 豪華 2.5L with ~20,000 km asking NT$388,000 and, one year older, a 2017 豪華 with 54,000 km asking NT$358,000. Against a NT$939,000 list (Yahoo 2016 Camry 2.0豪華 trim page, which I fetched and confirmed at NT$939,000) that is ~41% at 7 years, and the near-flatness between the 7- and 9-year points suggests those older cars have reached their floor. Higher-mileage 2019 cars (110,000-180,000 km at NT$268,000-438,000) sit well below. Anchor B (trajectory, optimistic): continuing from the year-5 figure of 66% at the ~7pp/yr typical of a Toyota sedan in years 5-7 gives ~52%. The honest range is therefore roughly 41-52%; I took 48%, slightly above midpoint because this car is a fresh, higher-priced imported model rather than an old locally-assembled design at the end of its run. CORRECTION vs the original record: it took 50% and justified the optimistic pick by asserting that the predecessor generation was 日本進口 so 'its import positioning matches ours'. I could not verify that claim from any source I could fetch, and it is inconsistent with the record's own year-5 basis, which uses that same predecessor as an ordinary depreciation trajectory — claiming an import premium on top double-counts. The unverifiable claim has been removed and the ratio trimmed to 48%. Also removed: the original record's supporting 'NT$558,000 2019 listing', which its own author admitted was never fetched and whose trim was unconfirmed — an unread single listing should not prop up a number. Ratio applied to list_price. 0.48 x 1,109,000 = NT$532,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12.5% to private sale (532,000 -> 466,000), then -14% to dealer trade-in (466,000 -> 401,000). Low confidence: this is extrapolation across a generation boundary with anchors ~11pp apart, not observation.

EXTRAPOLATED from the oldest Camry generation still trading in Taiwan — the only one old enough to supply a 10-year point. Real 8891 listings: a 2017 Camry 豪華 with 54,000 km asking NT$358,000 (re-verified by me in the main Camry listing) = 38.1% of a NT$939,000 list at 9 years, and a 2016 豪華 2.0L with 159,000 km asking NT$258,000 = 27.5% at 10 years. Reconciling for a 10-year-old car at this buyer's 70,000 km: the high-mileage 2016 car adjusted up for ~89,000 fewer km gives ~34.5%; the low-mileage 2017 car stepped down one year and slightly for extra km gives ~34%. Both converge on ~34-35%; I used 34.5%. The NT$939,000 denominator is the one figure in this chain I verified directly — I fetched the Yahoo 汽車機車 2016 Camry 2.0豪華 trim page and it returns 93.9萬. CORRECTION vs the original record: ratio applied to list_price (1,109,000) rather than real_cost, and set to 34.5% rather than 33% to match the two converging observations. 0.345 x 1,109,000 = NT$383,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -13% to private sale (383,000 -> 333,000), then -15% to dealer trade-in (333,000 -> 283,000) — the private/trade-in spread widens on older cars because dealer reconditioning is a bigger share of a cheap car's value. Low confidence: no 10-year data exists for this generation and none can, so this is a ratio transplanted from a two-generations-older, locally-assembled car.

maintenance.plan_notes: TIME-DRIVEN, not mileage-driven — the single most important fact for this buyer. Toyota Taiwan's scheduled interval is 每 10,000 公里或 6 個月，先到者為準 (confirmed by direct fetch of the TyAward Toyota maintenance breakdown, which also notes dealers push the half-year cadence to keep the extended warranty valid). At 7,000 km/yr the 6-month clock fires at only ~3,500 km, so the owner services roughly TWICE a year and never reaches the mileage trigger. Over 10 years that is ~20 visits for just 70,000 km, which is why cost per km (~NT$2.6/km) looks high while annual spend (~NT$18,500) stays moderate. Several items are on calendar intervals and hit on schedule regardless of distance: brake fluid every 40,000 km or 2 years, tires aging out at 5-6 years, 12V battery at 4-5 years, coolant around year 10. Toyota TW offers NO free scheduled-maintenance programme — every visit is paid. Factory warranty is 3 years / 100,000 km, so at this mileage it always expires on TIME at year 3; the 5-7y and 7-10y windows carry explicit out-of-warranty repair allowances. Cost basis: Toyota TW's published T-series packages (T30 NT$2,270 at 10k/30k/50k km, T50 NT$2,900 at 20k/60k km, T60 NT$3,970 at 40k km, the last covering air filter, brake fluid and coolant) are quoted for a 1.5L small car; a Camry 2.0 runs ~1.7x that, calibrated against a reported owner work order of NT$4,906 for a 20,000 km Camry 2.0 service. I used ~NT$3,600-4,000 per routine visit. period_cost is spend SINCE the previous checkpoint, not cumulative. 10-year total ~NT$185,000. NOTE ON SHAPE: the 3-5y window (NT$45,000) costs MORE than the 5-7y window (NT$29,000). This inversion is deliberate and correct for a low-mileage car — the first tire set and the first 12V battery both age out inside the 3-5y window on the calendar, while the 5-7y window has no tire or battery replacement in it. Cost otherwise rises with age.

checkpoints.source: The most expensive window before year 10, driven almost entirely by CALENDAR items rather than wear. At 35,000 km the original tires still have legal tread, but 5-year-old rubber on a heavy sedan in Taiwan's heat and humidity should be replaced — a set of 4 quality 18-inch tires fitted runs ~NT$24,000. The 12V battery also dies on age at 4-5 years regardless of distance (~NT$4,500 for a Camry-size unit; Toyota TW quotes NT$2,000-2,800 for small cars, verified on TyAward). Brake pads are NOT included: at 35,000 km of gentle low-mileage use they are not yet worn. 4 routine visits ~NT$15,200 plus brake fluid ~NT$1,800 gives ~NT$45,500, rounded to NT$45,000. This window costing more than the 5-7y one is correct, not an arithmetic slip — it is a direct consequence of low mileage pushing consumables onto calendar triggers.

checkpoints.source: The largest window and the least certain. 6 routine visits ~NT$24,000 (a 3-year span, so 6 semi-annual services) including the 60,000 km T50 major; second tire set ~NT$25,000 on the same 5-year age rule that triggered the first; second battery ~NT$4,500; coolant ~NT$3,000 (Toyota TW quotes NT$220/L and nominally first changes at 160,000 km, but it is universally done on age by year 10); spark plugs ~NT$3,500 (Toyota TW long-life plugs NT$560/unit on a small car, more for Camry iridium — replaced on age since 100,000 km is never reached); rear pads and front discs ~NT$8,000; brake fluid twice ~NT$3,600. The NT$15,000 out-of-warranty allowance is a judgement call, not a quote: a 10-year-old Camry with only 70,000 km is mechanically young but its rubber, dampers and accessories have aged on the calendar. CORRECTION vs the original record: it stated NT$84,000 while its own itemisation sums to ~NT$86,600; raised to NT$86,000. 10-year total across all windows ~NT$185,000 (~NT$18,500/yr, ~NT$2.6/km).

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr; every checkpoint uses the 7,000 km/yr midpoint (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km), roughly half the TW average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. Two consequences shape the model. (1) Maintenance is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven. Toyota TW's published interval is 每半年或1萬公里以先到者為準, so the 6-month clock always fires first (10,000 km would not bind until ~17 months). Verified on toyota.com.tw/owner_maintenance.aspx: T30 每半年或1萬公里, T50 每單數年實施 或 2萬公里起每4萬公里, T60 每雙數年實施 或 4萬公里起每4萬公里. Note the T60 TIME trigger (每雙數年 = every even year) - at 7,000 km/yr the 40,000 km trigger is nearly irrelevant, so the real cadence is a T30 plus an annual T50 (odd years) or T60 (even years), i.e. two dealer visits per year for ten years. Tires, brake fluid, coolant and the 12V battery age out before they wear out. (2) Resale sits above the mileage-blind average: at 5 years this car has ~35,000 km where a typical TW Camry has ~65,000 km, so low-mileage listings were used as the anchor. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance (強制險/任意險) are excluded by design and appear nowhere. No home charger applies - this is a self-charging hybrid that never plugs in. Warranty facts verified on toyota.com.tw/owner_guarantee.aspx?ishybrid=Y: whole vehicle 3年/100,000km plus a 和泰 top-up of 1年/20,000km = 4年/120,000km; hybrid battery 5年/100,000km plus 和泰 3年/60,000km = 8年/160,000km, for 2019MY onward. At 7,000 km/yr BOTH expire on TIME, not km - out of vehicle warranty from year 4 at ~28,000 km, and out of battery warranty from year 8 at ~56,000 km. The buyer gets no benefit from the generous km caps.

purchase.notes: Full trim name CAMRY HYBRID 尊爵 (2.5L), the lower of two hybrid trims (HYBRID旗艦 sits above at NT$1,250,000). The spec page confirms 2,487cc / 186ps / 25.3 km/l / E-CVT and 全新第五代 SELF-CHARGING HYBRID, identifying the car as the XV80 Camry, locally built by 國瑞 from 2024/06 production onward; zh.wikipedia confirms 和泰 committed to a Q4 2024 TW launch. The TW gasoline trim is a separate 1,987cc unit (171ps, 16.3 km/l), so the hybrid 尊爵 is not simply a hybrid version of the gasoline 旗艦. Caveat on model_year: Toyota TW's current spec edition is CAMRY 202407 A版, last updated 2025/04/01, so the lineup and prices on sale in Aug 2026 are unchanged from that edition; model_year 2026 denotes the year currently on sale, not a distinct spec revision. discounts NT$40,000: Toyota TW does discount, but Camry is a locally built, low-volume flagship sedan on a still-fresh generation, so cash 折讓 is modest - typically NT$30,000-60,000 as a mix of 現金折讓 and free accessories, versus NT$80,000+ on run-out or high-volume models. onroad_fees NT$35,000 = 新領牌照規費 and 代辦費 (NT$4,000-6,000 combined) plus the accessory pack essentially every TW buyer takes at delivery (隔熱紙, 行車記錄器, 腳踏墊, 鍍膜, 防鏽) at NT$28,000-32,000 in this price class. selling_costs.notes: Private-sale scenario for a mid-size sedan. The 過戶 government fee itself is only a few hundred NT$; the NT$2,000 covers the usual 代辦 service. Detailing is the biggest line - a clean, well-presented Camry is what lets a private seller hold the 9-13% premium over dealer trade-in that value_checkpoints assume, so it pays for itself. Listing fees on 8891/SUM run NT$1,000-2,500 depending on package length. Total sits at the low end of the 4,000-15,000 band because a sedan needs no special transport or storage.

value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED - the XV80 launched in TW Q4 2024, so there is almost no 1-year-old used stock. Anchored on the newest real comp found on SUM 汽車網: a 2024 CAMRY 旗艦版 with 10,175 km asking NT$899,000 車商售價 (dealer retail), i.e. a 2-year-old, essentially unused car. Stepping back one year gives ~NT$965,000 dealer retail for a 1-year-old hybrid 尊爵 at 7,000 km (85% of the NT$1,129,000 list). This is a deliberate CORRECTION of a prior estimate that put dealer retail at ~NT$1,030,000: that is 91% of list, only ~5% below what a buyer pays for a brand-new car net of the NT$40,000 discount, which no TW buyer would accept, and it is irreconcilable with the verified NT$899,000 two-year-old comp. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN, all from dealer retail: NT$965,000 dealer retail less 9% = NT$880,000 private sale (自售價; the tight end of the 8-15% band because a near-new low-mileage Toyota is easy to sell privately), then less ~10% = NT$790,000 dealer trade-in (車商收購價). The buyer also immediately loses the NT$35,000 of accessories and 代辦 that carry no resale value.

Extrapolated from real 3-year-old (2023MY) Camry listings verified on SUM 汽車網 today, all 車商售價 dealer retail: 2023 尊爵版 5,206 km asking NT$789,000; 2023 標準版 6,683 km asking NT$818,000; 2023 39,800 km asking NT$768,000. Cross-checked against 4-year-old (2022MY) cars at NT$735,000-758,000 (30,000-58,900 km) and a 2022 Camry Hybrid at 86,488 km asking NT$678,000. Our car sits at 21,000 km and is a hybrid, which carries a premium over the gasoline cars that dominate this age band, so ~NT$820,000 dealer retail is the anchor - at the top of the observed 3-year range but not above it. NOTE: a prior estimate used NT$860,000, citing '2023 油電尊爵 50,000 km 79.8萬' and '2023 油電尊爵 69,215 km 72.8萬'; neither appears in SUM's dedicated CAMRY HYBRID cut (23 cars, newest is 2021MY), so those comps could not be re-verified and the anchor was lowered to the listings that could. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: NT$820,000 dealer retail less 10% = NT$740,000 private sale, then less 12% = NT$650,000 dealer trade-in.

Extrapolated from a dense set of real 5-year-old (2021MY) XV70 Camry Hybrid listings re-verified on SUM today, all 車商售價 dealer retail: 尊爵 43,000 km NT$668,000; 尊爵 54,006 km NT$649,000; 63,339 km NT$698,000; 86,080 km NT$648,000; 87,409 km NT$718,000; and one 43,297 km NT$818,000 that reads as a 旗艦 or an aspirational outlier. The 尊爵-badged low-mileage cars cluster at NT$649,000-668,000. Our car has 35,000 km, below every comp, so a modest low-mileage uplift gives ~NT$710,000 dealer retail. This CORRECTS a prior anchor of NT$740,000, which sat above the entire 尊爵 cluster and implicitly leaned on the NT$818,000 outlier the same note claimed to exclude. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: NT$710,000 dealer retail less 11% = NT$630,000 private sale, then less 13% = NT$550,000 dealer trade-in. The 4年/120,000km vehicle warranty has already expired on time by this point, which is priced into the predecessor listings. Cross-generation extrapolation (XV70 standing in for XV80), but the same-age sample is dense.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor XV70 generation - no XV80 data can exist at this age. Real listings verified on SUM, all 車商售價: 2019 油電旗艦 82,464 km asking NT$698,000 (sum.com.tw/carinfo-766547.php, confirmed 2.5 hybrid 旗艦 on the detail page); 2018 hybrid 90,094 km asking NT$598,000; 2020 尊爵 hybrid 101,485 km asking NT$598,000 and 134,580 km asking NT$558,000. The NT$698,000 comp is the single highest in the 6-8 year band and is a 旗艦, so using it raw overstates a 尊爵. Bracketing instead: a 7-year 尊爵 at typical ~95,000 km sits near NT$600,000; our car at 49,000 km earns a low-mileage uplift, giving ~NT$630,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: NT$630,000 dealer retail less 12% = NT$555,000 private sale, then less 14% = NT$480,000 dealer trade-in; both gaps widen with age because dealers demand more margin on older stock. The hybrid battery warranty (8年/160,000km) is still live throughout this window, which supports the value here.

EXTRAPOLATED from the XV50 generation, the only Camry Hybrid actually trading at 10+ years in TW. Real 車商售價 listings verified on SUM: 2017 hybrid 122,000 km NT$326,000 (sum.com.tw/carinfo-767302.php); 2015 hybrid 128,673 km NT$288,000; 2015 hybrid 160,000 km NT$288,000; 2014 hybrid 147,023 km NT$288,000. Gasoline cars of the same vintage give the low-mileage signal: 2015 66,159 km NT$368,000 versus 2015 at 153,655-192,899 km at NT$268,000-298,000, i.e. roughly a 25% premium for less than half the mileage - a real premium, though smaller than at years 3-5, and one that does not compress to ~10% as a prior estimate claimed on the strength of a single listing that could not be re-verified. Applying ~25% to a ~NT$320,000 high-mileage baseline, plus the hybrid premium over these gasoline comps, gives ~NT$400,000 dealer retail. Retention cross-check: the XV50 Hybrid launched in TW Feb 2012 at NT$1,069,000 (G) / NT$1,199,000 (V) / NT$1,399,000 (Q) per zh.wikipedia; NT$400,000 against the NT$1,199,000 mid-trim is ~33%, and 33% of this car's real_cost of NT$1,124,000 is ~NT$375,000-400,000, consistent. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: NT$400,000 dealer retail less 13% = NT$350,000 private sale, then less 17% = NT$290,000 dealer trade-in. The steep fall from year 7 is partly real - the hybrid battery warranty expires at year 8 on TIME with only ~56,000 km on the car, and TW buyers discount post-warranty hybrids - and partly a generation artefact, since the XV50 was a weaker car than the XV70/XV80. Hence low confidence.

maintenance.plan_notes: Toyota TW's official schedule, verified on toyota.com.tw/owner_maintenance.aspx: T30 每半年或1萬公里 (oil, oil filter, drain plug washer, 30+ checks); T50 每單數年實施 或 2萬公里起每4萬公里 (adds 空調濾網 and 火星塞, 50+ checks); T60 每雙數年實施 或 4萬公里起每4萬公里 (adds 煞車油, 冷卻液, 汽油濾芯, 60+ checks). IMPORTANT CORRECTION over a prior version of this record, which treated T60 as mileage-only and concluded it 'arrives only once inside the 10-year window at about year 5.7': T60 carries a TIME trigger of 每雙數年 (every EVEN year). At 7,000 km/yr the 40,000 km triggers are almost irrelevant and the whole schedule is time-driven, so the real cadence is two dealer visits a year for ten years - a T30 plus an annual T50 in odd years or T60 in even years. That means five T60s inside the window, not one, and brake fluid / coolant / fuel filter recur on the even years rather than once. Toyota TW includes 滿月檢查 free and waives labour on the 首半年保養 for new owners (both confirmed on toyota.com.tw/Guidebook/), reflected in the year-1 figure; there is NO free scheduled-maintenance programme beyond that. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: Toyota TW publishes no price list - the maintenance page explicitly says 如欲獲得保養套餐內容與價格費用之詳細資訊，請洽 TOYOTA 全台服務廠. Every NT$ figure below is therefore a market estimate built on the officially sourced item lists at typical TW dealer parts-and-labour rates (roughly NT$2,700 for a T30, NT$4,500 for a T50 and NT$6,000 for a T60 on a 2.5L hybrid using 0W-16 synthetic), not a quoted price. Consumables are placed on AGE, not tread or wear: the first tire set is replaced at about year 5.5 on the 5-6 year rubber-age rule TW shops apply, which puts it in the 5-7 window, and only a partial provision for a second set is carried at year 10 because that set would not fall due until about year 11. Warranty context: vehicle 4年/120,000km and hybrid battery 8年/160,000km, both expiring on time at this mileage, so years 5-7 and 7-10 carry genuine out-of-warranty risk provisions.

checkpoints.source: Cost SINCE year 5, covering 35,000-49,000 km, and the first period fully outside the 4-year vehicle warranty. Scheduled work: year-6 T60 (~NT$6,000), year-7 T50 (~NT$4,500), two T30s (~NT$5,500). The first tire set goes at about year 5.5 on rubber age at ~NT$24,000 for four - the OE set has covered under 40,000 km with plenty of tread left, but Taiwan's heat and humidity make the 5-6 year rule non-negotiable. Wheel/tire size is taken as the 尊爵's OE fitment; if the 尊爵 runs 17-inch rather than 18-inch this line is NT$4,000-6,000 lower. Iridium spark plugs finally get done at the year-7 T50 (~NT$4,500 for four plus labour), deferred from earlier T50s because 7,000 km/yr never justified them. Front brake pads now due at ~NT$6,000 - late by combustion standards, which is the regen-braking benefit showing up. Plus an NT$8,000 out-of-warranty risk provision for the items that actually fail on 6-7 year old TW hybrids: the electric water pump, engine mounts and suspension bushings. checkpoints.source: Cost SINCE year 7, covering 49,000-70,000 km - the most expensive window, driven by age rather than use. Scheduled work over three years on the corrected cadence: two T60s at years 8 and 10 (~NT$12,000), a year-9 T50 (~NT$4,500) and three T30s (~NT$8,250), about NT$25,000 total. Second 12V battery ~NT$6,500. Tires carry only a partial NT$12,000 provision, not a full set: the first set went on at about year 5.5, so the second is not due until roughly year 11, just outside the window - a prior version of this record booked a full second set here and over-provisioned. Two risk provisions carry the rest: (a) NT$8,000 for hybrid-battery exposure - the 8年/160,000km warranty lapses on TIME at year 8 while the car sits at only ~56,000 km, and although Toyota packs in TW routinely exceed 15 years, a 和泰 replacement runs roughly NT$80,000-150,000 (independent rebuilds NT$40,000-60,000), so an expected value at a low single-digit failure probability is the honest booking, neither a full pack nor zero; (b) NT$18,000 for general 高齡車 out-of-warranty items - electric A/C compressor, suspension, radiator, belts. Ten-year total is ~NT$174,000, about NT$17,400/yr, high per km precisely because time-driven costs do not amortise over 7,000 km/yr.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years. Two consequences run through every number. (1) Resale: at every age this car carries about half the mileage of the typical 8891 listing, so it sits above the mileage-blind average. Where a low-mileage comparable existed I used it; where the only comparables were high-mileage (all the predecessor-generation Camry Hybrid points at years 7 and 10) I applied an explicit low-mileage uplift and said so. Note the genuine finding that the 2023 貴族版 asking prices on 8891 are identical (NT$1,150,000) at 23,000, 40,000 and 47,000 km, which reads as stale dealer pricing rather than a real mileage-blind market, so the uplift at year 3 is deliberately small. (2) Maintenance: Toyota Taiwan's published interval is 每半年或1萬公里 (every 6 months or 10,000 km, whichever comes first). At 7,000 km/year the 6-month clock always fires first (~3,500 km per interval), so servicing is entirely TIME-driven, never mileage-driven, and over the full 10 years the car reaches only 70,000 km without ever triggering a single mileage-based interval. The same logic makes tyres age out (rubber hardening at ~5-6 years) rather than wear out. This is a self-charging hybrid with no plug, so there is no home-charger installation cost at all — the issue does not arise. Tax (牌照稅/燃料費), insurance and fuel are excluded from this record by design.

purchase.notes: PRICE CONFIRMED. NT$1,570,000 was re-verified independently on Toyota Taiwan's own showroom page, so the scout figure stands with no change. DISCOUNTS — DOWNGRADED SOURCING. NT$25,000 (1.6%) is retained as a plausible figure for an allocation-capped Toyota, but I could not substantiate it. I re-fetched the 8891 新車菜單 page (c.8891.com.tw/menu/toyota/crown/share/18009) that the previous pass cited for a NT$1,545,000 成交價: the page returns only the title 'Toyota Crown 2025款 貴族版' and does not render 成交價, list price, discount, accessories, city or order date. The Mobile01 corroboration (1.5% cash discount) returns 403 to direct fetch. Both figures were originally read from search-result snippets, not page bodies, and neither could be re-confirmed. Treat NT$25,000 as a convention: a low single-digit discount is consistent with the Crown being supply-constrained in Taiwan, but the exact number is unsourced. ONROAD_FEES NT$48,000 = 領牌 + 代辦 ~NT$8,000 (statutory 規費 is only ~NT$1,250: 檢驗費 450 + 號牌費 600 + 行照費 200; the rest is 代辦手續費 and a normal plate) + 配件 ~NT$40,000 (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 腳踏墊, 鍍膜, scaled to a NT$1.57M car). This is ~3% of list, in line for the class, and is the softest line in the purchase block — a self-sourcing buyer lands well under it, a dealer accessory pack runs well over. ARITHMETIC: real_cost = 1,570,000 - 25,000 + 48,000 = 1,593,000. Tax, insurance and fuel deliberately excluded. MODEL YEAR: Taiwan does not really run model years; Toyota TW's spec table says '2025/04月起生產', so a car bought in August 2026 is the same 2025-spec 貴族版. model_year 2026 records 'the version on sale today'.
